title: AGENT.md frontmatter
description: Contract for neutral cross-harness agent definitions validated by compile-harness.sh before render (ADR-027). The definition is provider-neutral; the compile layer maps neutral fields (model tier, capabilities) and emits each harness's determinism hooks. Required = the universal subset every persona carries (name + description for the native agent file, kind to branch coexistence). Lives in the repo (not the vault) so validation runs offline, consistent with the skill pipeline (SDD-008).

name.description: Persona identifier; also the deployed agent file name.

description.description: When-to-invoke / trigger text the harness matches against.

kind.description: invocable = no 80_agents/ state; autonomous = persona cataloged here, live state in 80_agents/<name>/.

model.description: Neutral tier (top|mid|low); resolved to this harness's model id at deploy via harness/model-map.json, and emitted into the rendered frontmatter (#1161). A tier the map cannot answer fails the render rather than dropping the field — a definition naming no model is the degrade the routing registry exists to prevent (ADR-035). Absent = rendered with no model line.

capabilities.description: Neutral capability vocab (e.g. [read, search, edit, shell, web]); mapped to provider tools via capability-map at compile (H-044).

skills.description: Forced-consumption skills; compiled to the harness determinism hook (presence/action/dispatch).

targets.description: Optional per-agent harness allowlist (e.g. [claude]); absent = all harnesses.
